summary: Ellips is a family-owned Dutch maker of optical grading technology and software, based in Eindhoven and founded in 1989 by software engineers. With sister companies Elisam and Elifab it supplies camera-based grading machines, pre-sorters and retrofits for potatoes and other produce. It reports 85+ Elisam potato machines installed.
machines: Elisam AI potato grading machine: grades by size, shape, weight, colour and defects, 2 to 5 t/h per lane
Elisam CombiGrader: 4-lane grader for potatoes and onions, up to 15 t/h
CleanFlow Pre-Sorter: removes stones, clods and rejected product before storage or grading, up to 120 t/h
Retrofit: new cameras, electronics and software fitted to an existing grader
Ellips Internal Quality: light-transmittance scans for internal browning, hollow hearts and dry matter
Ellips TrueSort: grading software with dashboards, reports and traceability
markets: Named potato customers in the USA, Germany and Australia
facts: Founded in 1989 in Eindhoven; founder Erwin Bakker; CEO Erik Zeegers
85+ Elisam potato machines and 400+ potato grading lanes installed
3,500+ Ellips grading solutions in use worldwide
Elisam founded in Italy in 2010; Elifab founded in Spain in 2016
limitations: Staff numbers, prices and manufacturing locations are not published on the pages read.
The site does not say which locations build machines and which are sales or service offices.
